title: All geographic map surfaces share the Google-capable provider and Frequency styling

source.ref: Owner map screenshot and provider audit 2026-10-15

detail: City discovery, legacy Circle browsing and QR analytics bypassed the shared provider and always instantiated MapLibre, even when Google was configured. They now compose MapCanvas; count badges preserve aggregated totals independently of series moreCount, fit.points retains all pins while framing viewer plus nearest five circles, starter pins remain separate and device geolocation is opt-in with cleanup. Removed all three migration exemptions from map wiring guard. Google and fallback retain shared Frequency basemap styling, marker geometry, popup security and provider failure diagnostics. Screenshot purple exact-venue dot traces to place pin -> color-primary -> fq-action-primary -> old members violet role; existing mobile-cohesion alias override already points actions/links/focus to presence, so this packet deliberately does not duplicate the recolor. Local .env.local and process have no Google browser key or Map ID. No true Google runtime has been proved; provider activation requires restricted browsable Maps JavaScript key, enabled API/billing and rebuilt artifact, independently verified in browser. No provider provisioning, billing or production writes performed.

verify.evidence: 101 focused tests/7 suites pass including actual React GoogleCanvas with mocked Maps API preserving count badge text, subset bounds, remote pins and unclustered starters; scoped ESLint and diff checks pass. Required: rebuild candidate with configured NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_BROWSER_KEY, load event venue, Around You, Circle discovery, public city discovery and admin scan maps, observe Google map rendering/attribution and absence of provider fallback errors. Verify current aqua marker/action/focus colors in light/dark and Frequency Stage; verify zoom, popup links, location opt-in and keyboard navigation. Empty/bad key must retain working MapLibre fallback; this is not proof Google is activated. If a Cloud Map ID is supplied, its published Cloud style must independently match Frequency because Google ignores embedded JSON styling with mapId.
